 "study": "Huang et al. 2018",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",
 "country": "Taiwan",
 "duration": "18 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "92",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "LCD (low-carbohydrate diet)",
  "intervention_description": "daily carbohydrate intake ≤ 90 g/d",
  "n_randomized": "41",
  "n_analyzed": "41",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.44",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.59",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "9.95",

  "hba1c_final_mean": "6.84",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.59"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "TDD (traditional diabetic diet)",
  "intervention_description": "target total calorie intake, macronutrient percentage: 50–60% carbohydrates, 1.0–1.2 g/kg protein, ≤ 30% fat",
  "n_randomized": "42",
  "n_analyzed": "42",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.01",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "1.06",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "8.70",

 }
